name: Ironbloom Gearsteel Tooth
description: A machined tooth cast from oil-cured gearsteel.
specialEffects: Used in workshop weapons, recoil systems, and geared cutting heads.

steps: Refine raw stock for Ironbloom Gearsteel Tooth under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Ironbloom Refinery protocol before storage.
